TestAuthRoles::test_list_permissions.description: Single node, PasswordAuthenticator+CassandraAuthorizer. Builds a role graph (role1 -> role2 -> mike) with table grants and an ALTER-on-ROLE grant, then checks LIST ALL PERMISSIONS (incl. auto-granted creator perms for keyspace/table/roles, EXPORT when EXPORT_PERMISSION feature enabled), LIST ... OF <role> (inherited perms included), LIST ... ON ROLE role1, LIST DROP/ALTER PERMISSION ON ROLE with/without OF filter, empty result for unrelated role, and that a non-superuser can list its own (inherited) permissions. Guards LIST PERMISSIONS semantics for role resources and role inheritance (CASSANDRA-7653/8650 port).

origin.summary: Cassandra upstream: 7653 Tests for role based access control (Sam Tunnicliffe); extended in ac74a8727e for role admin perms (CASSANDRA-8650/7216)

TestAuthRoles::test_list_permissions_val.description: Non-superuser mike, granted role2 (which is granted role1), lists permissions OF role2 and OF role1 (roles granted to him) successfully, and gets Unauthorized for LIST ALL PERMISSIONS (everyone's) and LIST ALL PERMISSIONS OF john (role not granted to him). Guards authorization checks in LIST PERMISSIONS for non-superusers.

TestAuthRoles::test_drop_non_existent_ro.description: With roles_validity_in_ms=10000, runs DROP ROLE IF EXISTS mike (nonexistent), then CREATE ROLE mike, GRANT ALL on table, logs in as mike and SELECTs. Guards CASSANDRA-9189: superuser-status check in DROP ROLE IF EXISTS caching a nonexistent role in Cassandra's RolesCache, breaking later authz.

TestAuthRoles::test_drop_non_existent_ro.relevance: roles_validity_in_ms is not a Scylla config option (no match in db/config.cc), so the test's cache config is a no-op. Scylla's auth cache (auth/cache.cc) mirrors role records loaded from tables via load_roles/remove_role; no negative-lookup caching, so the CASSANDRA-9189 mechanism does not exist. Remaining flow (create role, grant, login, select) is basic.

TestAuthRoles::test_drop_non_existent_ro.reason: Guards Cassandra-only RolesCache bug (CASSANDRA-9189) via roles_validity_in_ms, which Scylla does not have; Scylla's cache (auth/cache.cc) has no negative entries. Remaining create/grant/login/select flow covered by test_grant_revoke_permissions (scylladb test/cluster/dtest) and cqlpy test_permissions.py. Note: never ran under pytest until 77db1bd (2023) because its name lacked the test_ prefix.

TestAuthRoles::test_roles_do_not_inherit.description: Creates mike (LOGIN=false) and with_login (LOGIN=true), grants with_login to mike, asserts LIST ROLES OF mike / OF with_login show per-role login flags. The real assertion (mike still cannot log in, i.e. LOGIN not inherited) is commented out due to scylla #4284.
